framing: E11-02 screens the separation state against a recovery feasibility envelope (orbitopt.flightlab.recovery.feasibility) BEFORE the planner searches: one reference rollout plus an analytic fuel floor decides IN/OUT and predicts the flight reason with zero search fevals. Envelope conditions: fuel floor (rocket equation on the separation velocity), corridor reach/miss/tilt/arrival-speed, closed-loop landing forecast, entry q and g, landing propellant reserve margin — every one measured on the planner's own physics. Era note: the DC8 hold-out arms are the E10-03 era (the DC7 sealed POWERED recipe flown on the DC8 vehicle, no grid fins); the envelope that applies to DC8 as authored (E11-01 grid-fin mission) is graded in parts A/B/E.
